note: What has shipped and what is planned next. Planned items are tracked as GitHub issues; order is not a commitment.

releases.headline: Full pipeline cockpit, generalized to any domain
releases.summary: Every page end to end: ingest and dataset import, cluster-assisted labeling, a keyboard-first review queue, class management, export, training, model comparison, and projects with in-app configuration — with no domain hardcoded anywhere.
items: Dashboard, Ingest, Clusters + cluster detail, Review (6 tabs + presets), Classes, Export, Train, Bake-off, Models, Settings
Region features driven entirely by the backend's served region profile — no region UI without one
Deployment annotation profiles (annotation-profiles.json) for an additional annotation slot
Client-drawn source-image overlay: boxes and labels drawn from served coordinates
Curation-strategy bar: review sorts, score chips, diverse selection, embedding-plot lasso
Stubbed Playwright end-to-end suite, a live read-only tier, and mutation testing
API contract vendored from the backend and checked by tests
Projects: switcher, `/projects` admin, edit, pause, copy settings, archive and a guarded delete
Combine projects wizard with a previewed class mapping, a job view and undo
Dataset import (path or archive, previewed, by-name class mapping) and Reprocess under the lock rule
Prompt-pack and region-profile editors: revisions, rollback, activation and test-on-a-crop
VLM endpoint registry, per-project activation and per-run selection with an external-images acknowledgement
Multi-box regions with per-box accept and reject, locks, and an Imported review tab
Cross-project model sharing, including a confirmed force-unshare
A per-project keyboard-shortcut editor
